sections.description:
LLMO Ready automatically adds Schema.org JSON-LD markup to your WooCommerce products to help them appear in results from generative AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Google SGE, Perplexity, and Claude. You create the Knowledge Packs in Libers Suite. When a UCP profile is sent to your shop, the plugin serves it so AI agents can discover your catalog.

Features

  • Automatic Schema.org JSON-LD injection – No manual coding required
  • WooCommerce integration – Seamlessly integrates with your product pages
  • AI-optimized content – Uses AI-enhanced product descriptions from Libers Suite
  • Generative search optimization – Designed for ChatGPT, Google SGE, Perplexity, Claude
  • UCP profile – Stores a UCP profile sent to your shop and serves it at /.well-known/ucp (ACP/UCP standard). The plugin does not send data out.
  • Agent-ready product lookup – The served profile describes product search and lookup for AI agents. Visibility only, no automatic checkout
  • Lightweight implementation – Minimal overhead
  • German translation (de_DE, de_CH, de_AT)

How it works

  1. Install the plugin
  2. Connect your shop in Libers Suite at app.libers.ai
  3. Create Knowledge Packs for your products and publish them
  4. The plugin adds Schema.org markup on the product page
  5. If a UCP profile is sent to POST /wp-json/llmo/v1/ucp-profile, the plugin serves it at /.well-known/ucp

Benefits

  • Improved visibility in generative AI search engines
  • Structured data for better product representation
  • A stored UCP profile is available to AI shopping agents at /.well-known/ucp
  • Compatible with modern AI-powered search tools
  • Enhanced product discoverability without changing your storefront

System Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Libers Suite account (a new account includes a 7-day trial at libers.ai)

Support

For support and questions:

  • Email: support@libers.ai
  • Website: libers.ai
  • Documentation: libers.ai/documentation
  • Dashboard: app.libers.ai

About LLMO Ready by Libers GmbH

LLMO Ready by Libers GmbH helps online shops optimize products for generative search engines. Better visibility in ChatGPT, Google SGE, Perplexity, and other AI systems.

Visit us: libers.ai
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “LLMO Ready Schema Markup”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/llmo-schema-markup/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Products → LLMO Schema for settings

After Installation

  1. Go to app.libers.ai/shops
  2. Connect your WooCommerce shop
  3. Import your products
  4. Create Knowledge Packs
  5. Publish with “WordPress Plugin” turned on in the shop settings
  6. The plugin adds Schema.org markup to those products
sections.faq:
Do I need a Libers Suite account?

Yes. The plugin reads product fields that Libers Suite writes to WooCommerce. A new Libers Suite account includes a 7-day trial at libers.ai.

Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

No, this plugin is specifically designed for WooCommerce. For other e-commerce platforms, we recommend using the JavaScript SDK.

Where can I find my Knowledge Packs?

Log in to app.libers.ai and go to Knowledge Packs. There you can create new packs and manage existing ones.

How can I see the Schema.org markup?

Visit a product page and view the HTML source code (right-click → “View Page Source”). You will find the Schema.org JSON-LD in the <head> section.

Does the plugin affect performance?

The plugin is lightweight and adds minimal overhead. There are no external API calls during page load.

Can I customize the Schema.org markup?

The plugin prints the Schema.org JSON stored on the product. It does not add its own filter for that JSON.

Does the plugin support multiple languages?

Yes. The plugin includes a German translation (de_DE, de_CH, de_AT). Additional languages can be added via .po/.mo files.

What is the UCP profile endpoint?

The plugin stores a UCP profile that is sent to POST /wp-json/llmo/v1/ucp-profile with a WooCommerce REST API key that has write permission. It then serves that profile at /.well-known/ucp on your shop domain. AI agents use this endpoint to discover your catalog (search and lookup only, no automatic checkout). The plugin does not call Libers Suite. If your hosting blocks /.well-known/* at server level, this endpoint may not be reachable.

What data does the plugin handle?

The plugin does not send product data, shop data, or visitor data to Libers Suite or to any other service. It reads product fields already stored in WordPress and prints them on the product page:

  • _llmo_schema_org as Schema.org JSON-LD
  • _llmo_faqs, or questions inside _llmo_schema_org, as a visible FAQ and as FAQPage markup
  • _llmo_description_ai and _llmo_title_ai when no stored schema is present
  • _llmo_og_title, _llmo_og_description, and _llmo_og_image as Open Graph tags when no SEO plugin already prints them
  • _llmo_knowledge_pack_id as a meta tag

A page load does not call an external API.

External services

This plugin does not connect to an external service and does not send data to Libers Suite or to any third party.

Libers Suite writes the product fields above through the WooCommerce REST API after you connect the shop at app.libers.ai. That connection is set up in Libers Suite, not by this plugin.

A UCP profile can be sent to your shop at POST /wp-json/llmo/v1/ucp-profile. The plugin stores the JSON and serves it at /.well-known/ucp. It does not request the profile itself.
